text:
Maria (People Ops): Hey team :wave: quick FYI — two new recruiters flagged that the ATS 'Interviewer quicklinks' dropdown is missing on candidate profiles for accounts created in the last 48h. Anyone else seeing this?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Interesting, I just tried with a test account and I can repro. The rest of the candidate view renders but that dropdown is empty. :thinking_face:
Lee (Recruiter): Yep saw it when onboarding Zoe yesterday. We told her to open the interviewer calendar link from the profile manually but that's annoying.
Jen (Talent): Is this a permissions thing or feature flag? New hire onboarding streams created a bunch of orgs during the weekend migration.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): My hunch is feature flag scoping. Quick check: grabbed the prod feature_flags table in staging — accounts created after the migration timestamp don't have the flag row inserted.
Maria (People Ops): Ugh. That explains the timing. Is there a safe way to patch without touching prod code?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Two options: admin console toggle per-org, or run a backfill SQL update scoped to org ids. I prefer console if we only need to flip ~20 orgs.
Ashley (SRE): If you want a one-off DB patch we can run it during low traffic. SQL would be something like:
```
UPDATE feature_flags
SET enabled = true
WHERE name = 'interviewer_quicklinks'
  AND org_id IN (/* list of affected org ids */)
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-20';
```
But confirm indexes and we can add LIMIT batch.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I'll pull the affected org ids and try the admin console first. If that fails we'll coordinate an SRE-run patch.
Lee (Recruiter): Could we also add a temporary banner in the ATS UI that says "Interviewer quicklinks temporarily unavailable, use calendar link above" so new recruiters aren't confused?
Jen (Talent): Good idea. Small copy: "If you don't see Quicklinks, click the Interviewer calendar link next to the candidate name." I can draft and post to #product-ux for a 1hr change.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Update — admin console worked for 18/21 orgs, still 3 failing (401 errors). I think those three were created during the DB migration window. Kicking to SRE. @Ashley can you take the 3 org ids when you have a moment?
Ashley (SRE): On it, please DM the org ids. I'll run a safe backfill tonight in 20-min batches and monitor error rates.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam to collect org ids and try console (done), Ashley to run DB backfill for 3 orgs, Jen to post temporary banner copy to product-ux. Can we aim to have this closed by EOD? :white_check_mark:
nats-bot: audit.log:feature_flag.updated — user=Sam (Recruiting Ops) — flag=interviewer_quicklinks — scope=18 orgs
Lee (Recruiter): Confirmed with Zoe — dropdown back for her account. Thanks!
Ashley (SRE): Backfill finished for 3 orgs, no errors. Verified interviewer_quicklinks true for all affected orgs.
Maria (People Ops): Amazing, thanks. I'll send a short note to the new hire cohort to say the UI inconsistency is resolved and CC recruiting ops.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Moving this thread to resolved. Filing a small postmortem and adding a unit to onboarding checklist to validate feature flags after org creation.
Jen (Talent): Added the checklist item. Closing. :tada:
